Your new role
• You support the implementation and maintenance of Business Continuity Management (BCM) and Operational Resilience across Allane Mobility Group

• You hold a degree in (Business) Economics or have completed a comparable qualification

• You enjoy working independently, are proactive, and well-organized
• You have a broad, cross-functional mindset, enjoy exchanging ideas with others, and prefer working in a team over working alone; you communicate confidently in English, the main company language - knowledge of German is a plus

jobs.occupation: Technical Project Lead (f/m/d) Footwear- Milwaukee® (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools, outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality.

The company maintains a global manufacturing and product development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth.

To strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible, we are looking for a

Technical Project Lead (f/m/d) Footwear– Milwaukee® Your responsibilities:

- Lead and develop NPD projects in EMEA in accordance with our development process on all technical aspects for design and development
- Responsible for the completion of assigned engineering projects within budgetary and scheduling guidelines
- Lead tradeoff discussions and conversations around risk management with cross-functional teams
- Drive design of project to meet market driven design guides and fulfill cost, timing, reliability, and manufacturing requirements
- Analyze, evaluate and select from design execution alternatives to best meet specification objectives and implement designs into mass production
- Accountable for technical elements of project execution including integration of complicated components and assemblies, material selection, packaging and safety, regulatory and standards compliance
- Conduct design and safety reviews as needed to gain necessary approvals for product development phase progressions
- Schedules, develops agendas, facilitates and documents project meetings, tracks project schedules to ensure adherence to timelines
- Regularly makes presentations of project status

Your profile:

- Bachelor's degree or further technical education, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
- Relevant experience in project management and product development
- Understanding of technical processes in engineering like product development and technical documentation
- Ideally relevant professional practice in safety footwear industry
- Good command of English, a European language is an advantage
- Advanced knowledge in MS Office application
- Extensive Knowledge in CAD systems
- Willingness to travel as required for business (approx. 30 %)

Your perks:

- An interesting position with an attractive company – recognized as a “top employer” by kununu
- 30 days of annual leave, home office opportunities, and trust-based working hours
- Free parking spaces directly next to the office and good public transport connections
- Fresh fruit, water and hot beverages for free
- Company fitness via “EGYM Wellpass”
- EAP (mental support for employees)
- Learning platforms such as “GoodHabitz” and “Learn TTI” for your professional development
- Special employee benefits via “Family & Friends” and additional corporate benefit

Are you interested?

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you will enjoy your career with us!

Send your application stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations directly via our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your application with the utmost discretion.

We look forward to getting to know you!

Techtronic Industries ELC GmbH
Human Resources – Agnese Cesarini · Max-Eyth-Straße 10 · 71364 Winnenden

Are you passionate about enabling scientists through technology and helping research teams succeed with reliable IT solutions?

Do you enjoy solving technical challenges, supporting laboratory environments, and working closely with both researchers and IT specialists?

If so, this is your opportunity to join Ascendis Pharma as our new IT Lab Administrator at our Research Site in Heidelberg, Germany.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. The position is part of the Lab IT Solutions team, supporting scientists and laboratory staff with specialized IT services, systems, and infrastructure. The IT Lab Administrator works closely with researchers, Global IT teams, and external service providers to ensure stable, secure, and efficient operation of laboratory IT environments.
Key Responsibilities

Provides IT support and troubleshooting for laboratory-related hardware and software in office and laboratory environments
Maintains and further develops local IT resources, including hardware, software, and licenses for specialized laboratory systems
Provisions and configures laboratory workstations, instrument-connected IT devices, and scientific software applications
Implements and documents IT capabilities and solutions supporting research laboratories
Collaborates closely with Global IT teams, subject matter experts, and external service providers to ensure aligned, compliant, and effective solutions
You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, completed training as a "Fachinformatiker”, or have a comparable qualification.
You have:

Solid IT fundamentals in Microsoft-based environments, including Windows clients, user accounts, permissions, software installation, and basic troubleshooting

A basic understanding of networking concepts such as IP addresses, DNS, network shares, remote access, and connectivity troubleshooting
A hands-on, service-oriented mindset and the motivation to learn specialized laboratory technologies

The ability to work both independently and as part of a team
Fluent English, both spoken and written

Nice to Have

Experience in laboratory environments and scientific software (e.g., Chromeleon, Unicorn, MassHunter, MassLynx)
Experience with databases (e.g., MSSQL or Oracle)
Experience with Azure DevOps and agile ways of working
Experience with backup and recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam)
Experience with IT service management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow)
Experience with Cisco enterprise networking and security technologies (e.g., firewalls, Identity Services Engine (ISE), network access control, VLANs, and NAT).
German language skills

Key Competencies

Proactive and solution-focused mindset
Ability and willingness to find the best solution in a fast-paced environment
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies

Remuneration package:
An attractive salary, a sponsored pension scheme (bAV), and exciting short- and long-term incentives
Onboarding:
Structured, well-proven onboarding program to give you a clear picture of your responsibilities and the company you will be working for
Training:
Internal & external trainings and conferences embedded in a well-resourced training budget
Transport connections:
Good connection to tram station, parking lots for cars and bikes
Mobility:
You decide whether you want to use public transport with a discount or lease a JobBike
...

What you do.

Key Responsibilities

AI Implementation & Deployment (ca. 75%)

- You design, build, and deploy production-ready AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact — from intelligent automation and AI agents to predictive analytics and generative AI applications
- You move fast, taking ideas from prototype to production, using modern frameworks (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen) and foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source LLMs)
- You integrate AI into existing business systems via APIs and data pipelines, ensure safe and reliable operation through governance and monitoring, and optimise performance and costs for commercial viability
- You work embedded within client organisations to understand real processes, drive adoption, and enable AI-led change

Business Process Transformation (15%)

- Map current business processes understanding how work gets done today, identifying bottlenecks, and spotting automation opportunities
- Design AI-enabled future states working with your Deployment Strategist and client stakeholders to reimagine processes with AI capabilities
- Assess AI feasibility evaluating which problems are well-suited for AI, which approaches to use, and what ROI to expect
- Define success metrics working with your strategist partner to establish measurable outcomes that demonstrate business value
- Collaborate on use case prioritisation helping identify which AI opportunities deliver the highest impact relative to implementation complexity

Technical Pre-Sales & Demonstration (10%)

- Build rapid AI prototypes creating working demonstrations of AI capabilities in prospect-specific contexts within days
- Demonstrate AI possibilities showing prospective clients what AI can do for their specific business challenges with concrete examples
- Provide technical credibility establishing trust with client technical and business leaders through demonstrated AI expertise
- Assess client AI readiness evaluating data quality, technical infrastructure, and organisational capability to support AI initiatives

What you bring along.

- Strong AI/ML implementation experience (2+ years) building and deploying production AI systems, with hands-on expertise in LLMs and generative AI (GPT-4, Claude, Llama), including prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, and AI agent development (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar)
- Strong Python skills, solid data engineering capabilities (pipelines, vector databases, ETL), API and integration experience, and practical ML foundations (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
- Proven experience shipping AI systems to production, with cloud infrastructure knowledge (AWS, Azure, GCP incl. GPU/serverless), full-stack development around AI applications, DevOps/MLOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, model versioning), and performance optimisation across cost, latency, and scalability
- Strong business outcome focus, rapid iteration mindset, pragmatic problem-solving, and clear communication with non-technical stakeholders
- Comfortable with change management, close collaboration with a Deployment Strategist, and selecting the right AI approach for the business problem
- Speed-oriented and autonomous execution, learning agility in a fast-evolving AI landscape, travel flexibility, entrepreneurial mindset, and ethical AI awareness (safety, bias, privacy)

Essential Requirements

- University degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
- Portfolio of production AI/ML systems you've built and deployed
- Fluent English (written and spoken) - additional languages (German, Spanish) are valuable for DACH and Spain regions
- Legal right to work in the region of employment (UK and EU)

Shape the future of our Microsoft Dynamics landscape and help drive our digital transformation. - Developer Languages like Java Script etc. are welcomed.

- Experience with agile methodologies, project management practices, and solution architecture principles.
- Proactive, solution-oriented approach with a strong ownership mentality and the ability to work under pressure in complex multi-tenant setups.

jobs.description:
Description

As a DFT engineer, you will lead the complete DFT solution for a chip project, with responsibilities spanning all aspects of semiconductor development.

Responsibilities

- You will create DFT specifications, create verification plans, and define the SoC test interface.
- You will develop and implement the DFT architecture and own its integration into large SoC blocks — including IP integration, system and control bus connectivity, and the integration of memories and hard macros.
- You will implement testbenches, generate directed and constrained-random tests, debug failures, run gate-level simulations, and close coverage.
- You will also generate structural test vectors, run synthesis and timing closure and work closely with Chip Architecture, DV, Physical Design, and Power teams to achieve first-tapeout success.
- Additional responsibilities include supporting STA, physical, power, and logical analysis for DFT modes, partnering with Test Engineers to bring up test vectors on silicon.

Minimum Qualifications

- B.Sc./M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Knowledge of Verilog and/or VHDL, and familiarity with simulators and waveform debugging tools.
- Exposure to a scripting language such as Python, TCL, or Perl, including familiarity with leveraging generative AI tools to support scripting and engineering workflows.
- Ability to fluently speak and write in English.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to industry-standard DFT concepts such as ATPG, JTAG, or MBIST.
- Knowledge of general logic design principles.
- Exposure to design verification methodologies, coverage analysis, and assertions.
- Good problem-solving and communication skills.
- Experience in large SoC design or verification — a plus.

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

Please upload your CV in English.

How you'll impact.

Proactive 1st Level Support. You are the first point of contact for all colleagues across our global offices. By working closely with your team, you ensure fast and solution-oriented IT support, on-site and remotely.

Reliable Client Management. You manage our client devices with precision, from Windows laptops to iOS smartphones. You handle rollouts, updates, and provide troubleshooting when needed, ensuring our IT runs smoothly every day.

Strong Office Infrastructure. You take ownership of maintaining our workplace and meeting room infrastructure, whether it's hardware setup or audio-visual systems,

Hands-On Project Involvement. You contribute to change initiatives and project work, and optimizing our internal IT environment.

Ownership of Key Processes. You take responsibility for recurring operational tasks such as managing internal ordering processes and asset tracking.

Empowered by Teamwork. You’ll join a dynamic and motivated IT team that values early responsibility and shared growth. Your ideas are welcome and your impact will be visible from day one.

What you'll bring.

A completed apprenticeship as an IT specialist in system integration or IT systems electronics technician or relevant professional experience.

Proven experience in end-user support, particularly in Windows environments, experience with iOS devices is an advantage.

A conscientious and flexible working style with a strong sense of responsibility.

A genuine enjoyment in supporting colleagues with professionalism, patience, and a service mindset.

You communicate fluently in English and German.

What we'll offer.

From day one, we invest in your grwoth and well-being - because your success fuels ours.

- Tailored training programs and personalized coaching to help you develop your strengths, deepen your expertise, and grow with confidence.
